ائتلفت (form VIII)

# اِئْتَلَفْتَ (iʔtalafta) /iʔ.ta.laf.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِئْتَلَفَ (iʔtalafa)
# اِئْتَلَفْتِ (iʔtalafti) /iʔ.ta.laf.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِئْتَلَفَ (iʔtalafa)
# اِئْتَلَفَتْ (iʔtalafat) /iʔ.ta.la.fat/: third-perso
